verdict.rationale: Phaser ships a hosted Game Agent MCP server and an examples API, so issuing scoped credentials to an agent is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence describes API keys, tokens, or permission scoping for agents. The licence-transfer and MCP-connection material concerns other capabilities and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
